text: Minderoo Foundation has committed over A$125 million through its Strategic Impact Fund, invested €5 million in the ReOcean Fund, and contributed more than US$13 million to the World Food Programme since 2022. Its humanitarian support in Gaza has reached approximately US$28 million by October 2024.
